title: Loans
subtitle: Mortgages and consumer loans, balances by the repayment schedule.

empty.title: No loans yet
empty.description: Add your first loan to see what you owe, what the interest costs you and when you will be debt-free.

summary.paymentsAfter: from {{month}} only {{amount}} · {{name}} will be paid off
summary.rateNote: weighted by balance · interest over the next 12 months {{interest}}
summary.fixationExpired: {{name}}'s fixation ended {{month}} – enter the new rate
summary.noFixation: no rate has an end of validity

chart.title: Debt trajectory
chart.subtitle: Balances so far solid, the future by the repayment schedules dashed.
chart.noteNoPayoff: Today {{today}} · at the current payments the debt is never paid off

table.title: Loans
table.subtitle: Sorted by balance
table.subtitleHidden: Sorted by balance · paid-off loans hidden

noResults.title: No active loans
noResults.description: Every loan is paid off. Tick "Show paid off" to see them.

footer.note: Balance = principal amortized by the payments to date, or the balance you entered as of a date

balance.title: Outstanding balance
balance.help: Moony reduces the balance with every monthly payment. If you know the real balance, for example from a bank statement, enter it with its date and the calculation continues from there.
balance.setManual: Set the balance as of a date
balance.noPayment: Without a monthly payment the balance is not reduced.

confirmDelete.title: Delete loan
confirmDelete.description: Delete "{{name}}"? Its events and property links go with it. This cannot be undone.

modal.addDescription: Principal, rate and payment are enough; the balance follows the schedule.
modal.editDescription: Change the loan terms; the balance is recalculated.
modal.endDateHelp: When the loan is contractually due
modal.rateValidityHelp: When the current rate's fixation ends
modal.startDateHelp: The balance is amortized from this date; payments fall on the same day of each month

valuation.automatic: Amortized from {{date}} ({{amount}}) at {{rate}} with {{payment}} per month.
valuation.manual: From your balance of {{amount}} on {{date}}, amortized at {{rate}} with {{payment}} per month.
valuation.static: No monthly payment is set, so the balance is not reduced: {{amount}} as of {{date}}.
valuation.belowInterest: The payment does not cover the interest, so the balance does not fall.

status.manual: Balance by schedule · from your balance as of {{date}}
status.static: No monthly payment · the balance does not fall

hero.delta12: over the last 12 months · {{percent}} of the principal repaid
hero.deltaSinceStart: since drawdown · {{percent}} of the principal repaid
hero.noPayment: without a payment the balance does not fall
hero.balanceAtEnd: until {{month}} · {{amount}} left at the end date

chart.notePast: Since {{date}}: {{principal}} of principal repaid and {{interest}} paid in interest
chart.noteAll: Until paid off you still pay {{total}}, of which {{interest}} is interest
chart.noteNoPayoff: At the current payment the loan is never paid off

stats.fixationNote: in {{duration}} · at {{up}} the payment is {{upPayment}}, at {{down}} {{downPayment}}
stats.remainingToEnd: until {{month}} · {{amount}} left · {{interest}} of interest still to pay

schedule.title: Repayment schedule
schedule.subtitle: Interest and principal in every payment · balance after it
schedule.footYears_one: {{count}} year · the interest share falls from {{from}} to {{to}} in the last year
schedule.footYears_other: {{count}} years · the interest share falls from {{from}} to {{to}} in the last year
schedule.empty: There is no schedule yet. Set a monthly payment (Edit) to see one.
schedule.method: Interest = balance × rate ÷ 12, one payment a month on the same day

whatIf.title: Extra payment
whatIf.subtitle: What it would do to the term and the interest
whatIf.hint: Compare the two options banks offer.
whatIf.termNote: You save {{interest}} in interest · the payment stays {{payment}} · ends {{month}}
whatIf.paymentNote: New payment {{payment}} · the term stays until {{month}} · interest lower by {{interest}}
whatIf.noEffect: Enter an amount up to the balance of {{amount}}.
whatIf.noPayment: Without a monthly payment the effect cannot be calculated – add it by editing the loan.

events.title: Events
events.extraPaymentNote: the schedule continues from the reduced balance
events.rateChangeNote: the schedule continues from the balance on this day
events.balanceCheckNote: the schedule restarts from this date

confirmDelete.title: Remove event
confirmDelete.description: The entry disappears from the chart and the list. The balance the event set stays in effect.

warnings.noPayment: No monthly payment is set, so the balance is not reduced. Edit the loan and add the payment to amortize it automatically.
warnings.paymentBelowInterest: The monthly payment does not cover the interest (about {{interest}} per month), so the balance does not fall. Check the payment and the interest rate.
warnings.balanceAtEndDate: At the end date ({{date}}) {{amount}} would still be outstanding. Check the payment, the interest rate and the end date.
warnings.scheduleTruncated: The schedule is cut off after {{count}} payments.

extraPayment.title: Extra payment
extraPayment.description: Lowers the balance on the day and recalculates the schedule; it appears in the chart as an event.
extraPayment.usedFor: The bank used the payment to
extraPayment.alertTerm: Paid off {{duration}} earlier, saving {{interest}} in interest.
extraPayment.alertPayment: New payment {{payment}} a month, the term stays until {{month}}.
extraPayment.alertTooMuch: The amount exceeds the balance of {{amount}}.
extraPayment.alertEmpty: Enter an amount to see the effect.

rateChange.title: Rate change
rateChange.description: From the given day the new rate applies; the schedule continues from that day's balance.
rateChange.alertNote: At a payment of {{payment}} the loan is paid off {{month}}.
rateChange.alertNoPayoff: A payment of {{payment}} does not cover the interest; the balance would not fall.

balanceCheck.title: Verify balance by statement
balanceCheck.description: Enter the balance from your statement; the schedule restarts from that day.
balanceCheck.alertNote: Difference {{delta}} · from {{date}} the schedule uses your balance.
